description: Source code for managing Bluetooth Object Transfer Service (OTS) objects, including object pool management, retrieval, addition, deletion, and iteration functions.

classes.name: bt_gatt_ots_pool_item
classes.description: Represents an item in the Object Transfer Service object pool, including a linked list node, the object data, and allocation status.

classes.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager
classes.description: Manages a list of OTS objects and a pool of object items, including functions for object management and instance assignment.

methods.name: obj_id_to_index
methods.description: Converts an object ID to an index in the object pool, considering directory list configuration.

methods.name: obj_index_to_id
methods.description: Converts an index in the object pool to an object ID, considering directory list configuration.

methods.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager_first_obj_get
methods.description: Retrieves the first object in the object manager list.

methods.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager_last_obj_get
methods.description: Retrieves the last object in the object manager list.

methods.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager_prev_obj_get
methods.description: Retrieves the previous object relative to a current object.

methods.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager_next_obj_get
methods.description: Retrieves the next object relative to a current object.

methods.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager_obj_get
methods.description: Gets an object by its ID from the object manager.

methods.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager_obj_add
methods.description: Adds a new object to the object manager pool.

methods.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager_obj_delete
methods.description: Deletes an object from the object manager pool.

methods.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager_obj_contains
methods.description: Checks if an object is contained within the object manager.

methods.name: bt_gatt_ots_obj_manager_assign
methods.description: Assigns and initializes a new object manager instance.
